additional_info.subject: Customer Complaint
additional_info.body:
The Type 2 socket is in error on SCB (It alternates between available and being faulty). I was able to chat with a customer who charged for 2 hours on this Type 2 AC socket. She charged the car to 100%. However, the transaction is 0€. Looking closer, the transaction shows 0.00 kWh on our monitoring software (See Photo). This seems to be due to the energy meter of the Type 2 socket which is out of order (See Photo). Personally, I tried charging but couldn't even get the charging started. There are therefore 2 problems: - we cannot (or rarely) launch a charge; - when charging starts, the energy is not counted because the meter does not work. These 2 problems may be related.
Warning: following this problem, I blocked the Type 2 socket because the customers' cables which manage to charge on the Type 2 socket remain blocked in the terminal.
